<thought>Start with a small test set of oxide compositions to ensure the batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool works correctly. Retrieve polymorphs for five common oxides, applying the given energy and count limits, and save them in the specified directory.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
  "compositions": ["TiO2", "SiO2", "Al2O3", "Fe2O3", "ZnO"],
  "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
  "max_per_composition": 3,
  "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_batch_retrieve_oxide_polymorphs_trial_12/oxide_polymorphs"
}
